name: Alchemical Hazards
summary: Caitlin Grassman in Menethil Harbor needs an intact spider gland to make more antivenom. The venomous marsh makes the ingredient hard to gather safely.

sections.title: A Whole Gland
sections.body: Caitlin Grassman in Menethil Harbor is making antivenom, but needs a venom gland from a spider at Thelgen Rock. She asks you to bring it back whole, so the venom does not spill away before it reaches her.

faq.answer: Caitlin Grassman in Menethil Harbor needs it to make more antivenom.

faq.q: Where does the gland come from?
faq.answer: Caitlin asks you to get a venom gland from a spider at Thelgen Rock, far to the southeast.

faq.q: Why does the gland need to stay whole?
faq.answer: Caitlin needs an unruptured gland so the venom does not spill before you bring it to her.
Caitlin needs the gland to make more antivenom.
